about_the_game:
Welcome to THE MONSTER GIRL MANOR!!!

Take a step into the Monster Girl Manor, a visual novel where you have the chance to meet the monster girls created by a creative team of VAs:

  • Method Switch

  • Dream Audio VA

  • Startlit Audio

  • Xena Alexander

  • Lacey Audayo (coming soon!)

This game currently features an introduction to one of four unique characters, each one created and voiced by one of our VA team members and featuring VTube models that you may or may not have seen live streaming!

Currently, each character has a brief but fully voiced introduction scene lasting about 10 minutes. These scenes are linear and very narrow in scope. However, as the game develops, it will be expanded to include date nights and relationship progressions that are often seen in visual novels and dating sims.

Please note that this game will be 100% FREE! It is not intended to make profit but instead to navigate several different popular characters from the catalog of our VA cast.

content_descriptors.notes: There is no nudity and only some mild sexual innuendo from time to time.
